chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazie, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Subah al-Kinani, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The pregnant woman whose husband has died, her expenses are provided from the wealth of her child which is in her belly.

key_terms.يُنْفَقُ عَلَيْهَا: Expenses are provided for her / She is maintained

ai.seo_question: Who pays for the expenses of a pregnant widow in Shia Islamic jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that a pregnant widow's maintenance is drawn from the unborn child's share of the father's estate, a ruling derived from the principle that the fetus is considered a legal heir with a reserved portion. This ensures the mother's sustenance is secured without depleting the father's estate before the child's inheritance is formally calculated, reflecting the Shia juristic emphasis on the fetus's independent legal personality.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Al Sabbah Al Kinany, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The pregnant woman widowed from her husband, her expenses are from the wealth of her child which is in her belly’.
en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il ibn Bazi‘ from Muhammad ibn al- Fudayl from abu al-Sabbah al-Kinaniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the maintenance of a pregnant widow is paid from the assets of the child in her womb.’”
